incident.cause: The parser omitted valid attachment ancestry nodes, so it could not bind the terminal quota error to the current prompt.

fix.scope: Accept validated primary same-conversation attachment ancestry only. Attachments cannot establish a prompt, quota rejection or authentication failure.
fix.unchanged: Hook admission, callback delivery, quota classification, writer custody and provider-wide switching boundaries.

native_comparison.fixture: An unchanged private prefix of the real native transcript, frozen at the byte boundary observed before the owner continued the conversation.
native_comparison.limit: Prompt identity was read from the native transcript. This comparison does not replay or prove delivery of the historical authenticated hook.

validation.environment_note: Two unrelated enrollment tests failed under sandboxed process-inventory restrictions on both baseline and candidate. Both passed with the required native process visibility; source guards were not weakened.

operations.owner_requested_switch: completed through the normal provider-wide coordinator after waiting for active Claude work
operations.reported_discussion: resumed on the selected login without a resume error; the owner subsequently continued it
operations.old_login_availability_correction: completed through one guarded existing Store.UpdateExhaustion CAS after validating native evidence and no later sign-in; only the inactive target quota fields and registry revision changed
operations.signed_release_installation: passed; both installed binaries and the running daemon match the verified signed release; existing discussion process, conversation and runtime identities were preserved
operations.reported_discussion_final_check: running, native initialized, exact lineage and provider directory preserved, selected-login runtime current, input released, no resume/backend error or pending switch
operations.all_running_managed_discussions_after_in: native initialization and current account runtimes verified; no resume/backend errors, held input fences or pending switches

scope_note: The native comparison proves the confirmed attachment-parser defect and its correction. It does not establish callback-versus-transcript flush ordering or change the no-replay policy for failed user requests.
